answer_1.quote: recent studies used language models (LMs) as automatic reflection generators to aid training

answer_2.quote: Human evaluation of reflection generation is crucial, since automatic metrics are often not robust

answer_4.quote: we recruit a group of MI experts and a group of laypeople as annotators
answer_4.guideline: For each reflection, the annotator chooses Yes/No regarding whether it is coherent. If the answer is No, the annotator selects one or more applicable incoherence error categories
